string.text:
Find weapon and outfit parts in better condition. Each level: +0.5 percentage points, up to +15. Item pools and toolkit rarity stay unchanged.

Experience: a new find on the ground, in a stash or on a corpse gives 10; a part gives 20. Repeat pickups, purchases and transfers from living characters give no experience.
Scrounger improved: found parts will be in better condition.
